name: menu-morph
title: Menu Morph
description: Menu button morph for vertical reels: a brand-red round button pops, its bars cross into a close mark and action pills fan out beneath. Actions and button size are fields. Brand palette tokens, Montserrat, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="menu-morph": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Actions
variables.description: Comma separated labels for the pills that fan out under the button. Up to six.

variables.label: Button size
variables.description: Diameter of the round button in pixels. The bars scale with it.
